title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of Solar System bodies. A frozen 50-body Pilot-0 frame now separates a definitional IAU benchmark from non-definitional physical-signature models, so QCA can audit set-theoretic classification without circularly rediscovering the official definition.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C user-requested project registered 2026-09-24. Initial framing separates definitional classification from causal inference, identifies Mars as a positive control rather than an unresolved planet-vs-satellite case, and freezes a first-pass variable-family and source plan. Pilot-0 froze a 50-body stratified Solar-System case frame, canonical raw-variable dictionary, compact 4–6-condition model ladder, anti-circularity benchmark, and deterministic frame validator before numerical QCA solutions were inspected.
